description: An older man with a white wig and dark coat stands at right, one hand raised mid-gesture, facing a crowd of men in tricorn hats and dark coats packed behind a wooden rail in a panelled hall with tall arched windows. A younger man in a white shirt leans on the rail at centre, looking up. A clerk sits at a desk at right with papers and an inkwell, and two robed figures sit on a bench in the background. Warm brown, oil-painted look, with scattered paper on the floor.
